mentions.name: Automated hyperparameter reasoning evaluation system
mentions.description: An automated evaluation system that converges on the most effective hyperparameters per model for reasoning tasks, with planned follow-on work to optimize system prompts for various tasks (using DSPy or a homegrown system) and MCP servers that expose these capabilities to LLMs.
mentions.problem: It is important to know the most effective hyperparameters per model, and an automated system is the best way to converge on those numbers.
